title: Today's cash card for managers
problem: On the phone the owner could not see where today's money was, and Finance and Home disagreed with no reason shown.
now: Home and Finance show each open drawer's expected cash, today's pickups, shifts closed and the COD couriers still hold.
steps: Sign in as the owner and open the app's Home
Find Today's cash under Needs you
Open Finance: the same card is under the figures
Tap COD with couriers to open Payouts
notes: Where: App: Home and Finance (/m-home, /m-finance) · Needs the server: A drawer open on another device only counts the sales this phone has seen.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
